svg.title: Three ways watsonx.data integration moves data
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Batch: design batch pipelines once and run them on premises, in the cloud or across hybrid environments. Streaming: ingest and process streaming data with low latency, protected against schema changes and data drift. Replication: capture and deliver only the required changes.
